{{Top|leg}}
A '''cometduster''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage that was popular in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The drink was known to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who once specifically ordered a pair for himself and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in a [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] bar. It was also a drink that [[Celia]], a dancer at the bar, knew how to make without difficulty.<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

Once mixed, a machine excited the molecules in the drink which gave the drinker a mild electrifying sensation in the tongue.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
